source: Threads cooperate, so some kernels require synchronization. ZXNAME0000XZ's __syncthreads() is a block-wide barrier: every non-exited thread in the block must reach the same barrier instance, or exit, before waiting threads can continue. It also provides the required memory ordering among participating threads.[1]
zh: 线程之间进行协作，因此某些内核需要同步。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的 __syncthreads() 是块范围的屏障：块中每个未退出的线程必须到达相同的屏障实例或退出，然后等待线程才能继续。它还提供参与线程之间所需的内存排序。[1]
